$comment: Phase 2c: god powers. The numbers behind every power (src/sim/god.js). Favour regenerates perDay per game day up to max and is charged when a command is applied; in a Sandbox game every power is free. costs.settler is per settler. A scenario may name a different godRules with its optional `god` id; otherwise core:god applies. costs.omen is the harmless test power (it only writes a line in the log) that exercises the command queue.
